Solutions: Who uses our products and how?

Get the scoop on some of the most common use cases among different industries.

  • Product catalogs come with pop-up image galleries, so manufacturers can save space on the page when presenting new collections. And with a clickable table of contents, clients find the items they need in seconds, even in catalogs of 100+ pages.

    More on catalogs in manufacturing﻿

  • Marketers generate quality leads with their marketing collateral and then analyze lead activity in FlippingBook’s dashboard or their own CRM. They can also engage their target audience with videos that play right within the page.

    More on FlippingBook for marketing﻿

  • Property brochures created with FlippingBook give real estate agents a competitive edge, because they look professional and can be linked to 360 virtual tours with ease.

    More on FlippingBook for real estate﻿

  • Sales proposals and catalogs are available as direct trackable links, so sales reps can see how exactly each lead interacts with them! They can track lead activity on the go in our mobile app and use this info for timely follow‑ups.

    More on FlippingBook App for sales﻿

  • With FlippingBook, schools can save thousands of dollars on printing. Online textbooks are engaging, interactive, and packed with links to useful resources. And embedded online forms let students take assessments right within the textbooks.

    More on FlippingBook for education﻿

  • Online employee benefit guides surpass plain PDF versions and print copies that go to waste. Digital guides look professional, cut printing expenses, and are available on any device.

    More in our case study﻿

  • Nonprofit organizations reach more investors and beneficiaries with reports embedded directly on their site. Animated graphs and numbers deliver the value of the organization in a format that’s easy to remember.

    More on annual reports for nonprofits﻿

How to create a digital flipbook

Go beyond static PDFs with interactive flipbooks, magazines, proposals that are easy to share as direct links, and then track how clients interact with them.

  • Upload your PDF to FlippingBook. It'll be converted into a digital flipbook that looks just like a physical copy on any device.

  • Customize your publication: add your company branding and interactive elements, such as videos, outbound links, pop-up images, and a lead capture form.

  • Once your publication looks its best, share it with clients: email a direct link to them or embed it right into your website making it an integral part of any page.

  • Learn how your content performs: track page views, outbound clicks, time spent in your document. Understand your audience better to empower your marketing and sales.

FlippingBook digital publication examples

FlippingBook features that help our customers

Documents created with FlippingBook digital publishing tool are packed with smart features to empower marketing, sales, HR, and other professionals.

Watch video

Unique design

Make each flipbook a clear extension of your brand—add a clickable logo, customize the direct link to your flipbooks, set the background and the color palette to reflect your company style.

Learn more

Easy sharing

With FlippingBook, your PDFs turn into links you can share anywhere: email them directly, post to socials, or embed into your websites. Share single flipbooks or entire collections with interactive digital bookshelves.

Learn more

Content analytics

You can measure how your flipbooks perform, thus empowering your marketing. Learn how many views a flipbook gets, which pages engage your audience, which outbound links are the most click-worthy.

Learn more

Interactivity

Enrich your flipbook with interactive elements embedded anywhere on the page: add video tutorials for stronger engagement, insert pop-up images and external links to useful info.

Learn more

Content protection

Making sure that your content is secure on the web is vital. You can protect your flipbook from downloading and sharing, set a password, or make it accessible only within specific websites for tighter document security.

Learn more

Mobile-friendly content

Your flipbooks are available as direct links in any browser, on any device. Give your audience an authentic reading experience in the mobile world with lifelike flipbooks.

Learn more

FlippingBook integrations

You can integrate FlippingBook with other apps for a more powerful experience and a smoother workflow across your entire team.

Canva

Create a PDF in Canva or use one of our Canva templates and then send your content right into FlippingBook with our seamless integration.

Google Analytics

Integrate a Google Analytics code right into your flipbook for deeper insights on how clients interact with your digital content.

WordPress

Install and activate the FlippingBook plugin on your WordPress site. This will let you embed gorgeous flipbooks on your website.

Zapier

You can connect any app with FlippingBook to set up a seamless workflow. Zapier integration lets you do it all–from delivering leads in your CRM to getting notifications in Slack or creating flipbooks automatically. Build your own workflows or use our pre-made templates for popular apps, and automate the tasks you hate.
